# About Access Policies Defined by Partners

Access policy rules defined by partners provide role-based access control for
applications shared through Business-to-Business (B2B) Federation. The
**Defined by Partners** page lists rules created by the guest partner for the
host partner's applications. The **Defined by My Tenant** page lists rules
defined by the host for its internal applications and users.

On **Policies > Access Control > Private Applications > Access Policy >
Defined by Partners**, administrators can view and save filters, hide or show
filters, refresh the page, filter by partner, expand policy rows, modify table
columns, paginate, and navigate to Defined by My Tenant.

Each policy row exposes its name and rule action. The documented rule-action
values are **Allow Access**, **Block Access**, and **Require Approval**.
